strings.cover-title: A Day Inside a Bilingual School
strings.cover-lead: From morning reading to club time, one morning shows how your child learns here.
strings.day-caption: Image: a synthetic colour band for geometry regression, not a real campus photo.
strings.day-p1: Morning reading starts at eight. Children read a story aloud in Chinese, then retell it in English. Teachers note how often each child is willing to speak, not only whether they are right.
strings.day-p2: The second period is project time. Grade 3 is studying the plants on campus, writing observation notes in both languages and presenting them to younger pupils on Friday.
strings.day-p3: Break time is split between the playground and the library. On rainy days the PE teachers move activities into the indoor gym.
strings.day-p4: Before lunch at 11:30, every class has ten minutes of sharing time. On Open Day you are welcome to sit quietly at the back of the classroom.
strings.day-contact: To book a visit, call the admissions office on 0571-8888 6666 at least three days before Open Day.
